english.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for saying that something may happen.
Use this common alternative when presenting something as a possibility or giving a tentative “maybe” reply.

examples.jyutping: waak6 ze2 teng1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5 wo3
waak6 ze2 ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 sin1 heoi3 laa1

english.note: This is the all-purpose way to introduce another option in everyday Cantonese.

examples.english: Do you want rice, or alternatively noodles?
examples.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 sik6 faan6 waak6 ze2 sik6 min6 aa3
